decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already fully records that randomly allocated no-referral commissions must appear in NFT attributes.
The source Event changes commission visibility, not ticket accounting; the conditional discussion of whether no-code buys generate tickets establishes no confirmed ticket-rule change.
Displaying randomly allocated commissions does not change which successfully minted NFTs must appear in the dashboard inventory.
Commission accounting visibility does not affect NFT image, cover, or wallet-media rendering.
The source requires visibility of randomly allocated commissions, not a change to displayed referral counts.
A no-referral commission is not recorded referral activity, and the source does not change public referral statistics.
The source establishes dashboard and NFT-attribute presentation behavior but does not require a confirmed FAQ-content revision.
Random commission visibility does not alter the public countdown label or its sales-remaining measure.
The source does not change prize-pool values or how public prize-pool statistics are calculated or displayed.
The commission-display decision does not affect the counting basis for public mint statistics.
The source does not entail a revision to the About page's description of referral or reward mechanics.
The source changes presentation of randomly allocated commissions but does not change their amount, allocation condition, recipient-selection rule, or existing first-mint ambiguity.
